topics.headline: From "paper car" to pole – What changed for Verstappen and Red Bull?
topics.summary: It is less than a month since Max Verstappen qualified sixth at Monza and afterwards spoke about a Red Bull car "made of paper".

topics.headline: Max Verstappen reveals Valentino Rossi wish ahead of Portimao GT3 season finale
topics.summary: Four-time Formula 1 champion Max Verstappen says he hopes to avoid an on-track battle with Valentino Rossi when the pair share the GT3 starting grid for the first time at Portimao.

topics.headline: Max Verstappen responds to George Russell: "Maybe I should take him to the sauna!"
topics.summary: The debate over cooling vests has been revived during the Formula 1 weekend in Malaysia.

topics.headline: Verstappen takes first Red Bull F1 pole of 2026
topics.summary: Max Verstappen claimed the first non-Mercedes-powered F1 pole position of 2026 in Malaysia, while Mercedes suffered its worst qualifying of the year

topics.headline: F1 Bahrain GP in Malaysia: Verstappen dominates for first pole of 2026 from Hamilton
topics.summary: Max Verstappen took his first pole of the 2026 Formula 1 campaign to deliver on his early weekend promise by dominating qualifying at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia.

topics.headline: Max Verstappen makes Red Bull progress claim with ominous Malaysia warning
topics.summary: Max Verstappen hasn't sat on pole since the 2025 Formula 1 season closed at the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix.

topics.headline: Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton go viral after "wholesome" Sepang F1 moment
topics.summary: A "wholesome" moment between Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton has gone viral after qualifying for the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia.
